title: Analysis of Variational Sparse Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2509.22994v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Variational sparse autoencoders (vSAEs) replace a sparse autoencoder's deterministic Top-K mechanism with a sampled Gaussian posterior hypothesized to produce a more robust feature dictionary. To test this, we build permutation comparisons over training seeds for custom analyses, and score two popular benchmarks on one pair of existing checkpoints. When fixing the unit variance and ablating sampling on the vSAE, we find that the gap between the non-sampled vSAE and a Top-K SAE with an L2 activation penalty can be decomposed completely into a set of five implementation details. When we enable sampling and allow the network to learn its own variance, we find that the discrete selection process of Top-K fails when in conjunction with stochastic sampling methods. translated_title: 变分稀疏自编码器分析
translated_abstract: 变分稀疏自编码器用采样得到的高斯后验取代了稀疏自编码器中确定性的 Top-K 机制，据假设这能产生更鲁棒的特征字典。为验证这一假设，我们构建了基于训练种子的置换比较以进行自定义分析，并在一对现有检查点上对两个流行基准进行了评分。当固定单位方差并在 vSAE 上消融采样操作时，我们发现非采样 vSAE 与带 L2 激活惩罚的 Top-K SAE 之间的差距可以完全分解为五个实现细节。当我们启用采样并允许网络学习自己的方差时，我们发现 Top-K 的离散选择过程在与随机采样方法结合时会失效。在这些模型训练所采用的噪声尺度下，相同的模型激活仅因采样过程就会产生截然不同的 Top-K 特征集（Jaccard 相似度为 0.075-0.29，而随机水平为 0.067）……
tldr: 本研究通过置换比较分析变分稀疏自编码器，发现非采样 vSAE 与带 L2 激活惩罚的 Top-K SAE 之间的性能差距可完全分解为五个实现细节，且 Top-K 的离散选择机制与随机采样方法结合时会失效。
en_tdlr: Analysis of variational sparse autoencoders reveals that the gap between non-sampled vSAEs and Top-K SAEs with an L2 activation penalty is fully attributable to five implementation details, and that Top-K's discrete selection process fails in conjunction with stochastic sampling methods.
